selectionReason: The issue #60 rule selects up to ten absent Joyo kanji in frozen source-row order, with one support-word article per selected kanji. A qualifying support word uses JMdict news1, ichi1, spec1, or gai1; news2/spec2 do not qualify. The selected rows 63, 67, 68, 72, 120, 123, 125, 126, 131, and 132 are the first ten remaining Joyo rows after B157. Every support word's other kanji already has a card. 升 is the sole priority-tag exception: no candidate written with 升 carries a qualifying tag, so the rule's untagged route applies. 升 ます (1346290) carries only news2/spec2 and matches the first KANJIDIC2 meaning, “measuring box”; 升 しょう, 一升, 一升瓶 and 升目 are untagged. The row-specific justification is in the 升 support mapping and must receive independent review.

supportMappings.exceptionReason: No candidate written with 升 carries news1, ichi1, spec1, or gai1 in the pinned snapshot, so the untagged route of the issue #60 rule applies, with a row-specific justification. 升 ます (entry 1346290) is the only 升 entry with any priority marker (news2/spec2, treated as untagged). Its spelling and reading carry no irregular, rare, outdated, ateji, or gikun mark; ます is a KANJIDIC2 reading of 升; and the word is the single kanji, so it needs no other card. Its sense 1, “measuring box,” matches the first KANJIDIC2 meaning of 升 and the card's main meaning, and it backs the quizzed kun reading ます. The alternatives are all untagged: 升 しょう (2248100) is the volume unit; 一升 (1163460) and 一升瓶 (1163470) use the unselected ショウ reading; 升目 (1654590) is a derived word. Keep this explicit untagged exception for independent review, as with 仙人 and 伯仲 (B156) and 諸侯 (B157).
